biography.value: Mountain Hearts grab things and do not let go. They spend actions building toward a Grapple and then Engulf the most dangerous held target to remove them from the fight entirely. Against opponents too large or strong to Grapple efficiently they simply hit very hard and regenerate. A summoner who needs something physically held — not slowed, not intimidated, but literally held in place — will find nothing better at this tier.

system.attacksNotes:
Crushing Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 10 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str).
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled; no save; Grappled target takes 8 bludgeoning damage at the start of each of their turns.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + Grappled + Restrained + ongoing 8 damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone by non-magical forced movement. Shoves automatically fail unless the attacker wins an opposed Strength + Athletics [Hard] check. Earth Bond: While standing on natural earth or stone, regains 6 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Engulf (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: Drives a Grappled target partially into the earth. Target must already be Grappled by the Mountain Heart. Target makes a Fortitude [Hard] save. Failure: Restrained, Blinded, and takes 4 bludgeoning damage at the start of each turn. Escape requires a Might/Acrobatics [hard]check as a full [Combat] action, or an ally must dig them out over 2 rounds of [Interact] actions. On 1 success: Restrained only, not Blinded.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 8.
